divergenceCases.limitation: desired-to-performed overlap takes only 2 distinct value(s) (histogram 0/0/5/7/0/0), so there is no low-experience/high-direction group; disliked-to-performed overlap is constant at 5 for every person, so "rejects work they performed" is the whole corpus rather than a testable subgroup

notes: Job interpretation is excluded from user wait: JobBlueprints are precomputed per job and amortised across every user.
Distributions cover FRESH calls only; cache hits are a separate population because mixing them reports a p50 of ~0ms.
Parallel critical-path figures are DERIVED from calls timed individually and exclude concurrency contention, so they are a lower bound.
p90/p95 are single order statistics below 20 samples and are not percentile estimates.
Model compute, network round trip and provider queueing are reported together; the API exposes no server-side timing to separate them.
